description: Use this when you need facts about a US mortgage lender, bank, credit union or mortgage broker company, by its company NMLS ID or by name (a partial name works). Returns the lender's type (bank, credit_union, imb, broker, other), headquarters state, website, the loan programs it offers (such as FHA, VA, jumbo or DSCR), program_approvals from agency data (FHA approval per HUD, with the month of loans it covers; absent means no HUD match on file, not that the lender lacks approval), activity (home loans it funded per HMDA, FFIEC/CFPB: counts by year, loan type and purpose, with as_of_year and source_url; cite it as 'HMDA, FFIEC/CFPB, <year>'; includes_brokered true means the counts include loans brokers originated; absent means no HMDA match on file, never that the lender makes no loans), how many of its loan officers LenDb lists, disciplinary_check, the date the record was last verified and a canonical_url.

nmls_id_or_name.description: Company NMLS ID (digits) or all or part of the company name.

name: get_lender

sample.description: True when the data is fictional sample data.
